title: 4th sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/4/2024).
First reading of the Bill to amend the Health Services Act (Law No. 29/2015), submitted on behalf of the government by Henveiru South MP Hussain Imran Latheef.
First reading of the Sovereign Development Fund Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Fuvahmulah Central MP Ali Fazad.
Preliminary debate on the Bill to amend the Maldives Immigration Act (Law No. 1/2007), submitted by Galolhu South MP Meekail Ahmed Naseem.
Report of the Government Oversight Committee on the matter of giving Parliament's consent to three ministers appointed by the President to the Cabinet under Article 129(a) of the Constitution.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to introduce two government bills, debate an immigration law amendment, and take up a committee report on confirming three Cabinet ministers.
